sql.where:
G.PRJ_ID = #{prjId} AND G.STATUS_CD = '01ACTIVE'
AND G.NAME LIKE '%' || #{grpName} || '%'
AND TRUNC(G.CREATED_ON) >= TO_DATE(#{createdFrom}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND TRUNC(G.CREATED_ON) <= TO_DATE(#{createdTo}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')

mapper.select:
SELECT G.ID AS id, G.NAME AS grpName, COUNT(M.USER_ID) AS cntMem, G.CREATED_ON AS createdOn FROM GRP G LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON M.GRP_ID = G.ID
GROUP BY G.ID, G.NAME, G.CREATED_ON ORDER BY G.ID

SELECT G.PRJ_ID AS prjId, G.ID AS grpId, P.PRJ_NAME AS prjName, G.NAME AS grpName, G.CREATED_ON AS createdOn FROM GRP G LEFT JOIN project P ON P.ID = G.PRJ_ID WHERE G.PRJ_ID = #{prjId} AND G.ID = #{grpId} AND G.STATUS_CD = '01ACTIVE'

SELECT M.USER_ID AS userId, U.NAME AS userName, U.TEL AS tel, U.EMAIL AS email, G.NAME AS grpName FROM MEMBER M JOIN USERS U ON U.ID = M.USER_ID JOIN GRP G ON G.ID = M.GRP_ID WHERE G.PRJ_ID = #{prjId} AND G.ID = #{grpId} AND G.STATUS_CD = '01ACTIVE' ORDER BY U.NAME

SELECT DISTINCT R.ROLE_CD AS roleCd, R.ROLE_NAME AS roleName, R.CREATED_ON AS createdOn, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS remark FROM GRP_ROLE GR INNER JOIN ROLE R ON R.ROLE_CD = GR.ROLE_CD AND R.PRJ_ID = #{prjId} WHERE GR.GRP_ID = #{grpId} ORDER BY R.ROLE_CD

SELECT M.ID AS memberId, M.USER_ID AS userId, U.NAME AS userName, U.TEL AS tel, U.EMAIL AS email, G.NAME AS grpName FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.ID = M.USER_ID LEFT JOIN GRP G ON G.ID = M.GRP_ID WHERE G.PRJ_ID = #{prjId} AND G.STATUS_CD = '01ACTIVE' ORDER BY U.NAME, M.ID
